summary: The Agent Market performance foundation and database migrations are deployed, but the production browser-to-public-Evidence closure is not yet presented as verified.
limitations: No real production browser event has completed the Cloudflare, AWS, PostgreSQL, and public Evidence readback chain yet.
The AWS consumer remains enabled only for the controlled acceptance run and will be paused after public Evidence readback succeeds.
nextStep: Deploy the Cloudflare production site, run one controlled Web Vitals event end to end, publish the sanitized readback, and reversibly pause the AWS consumer.
